articles.title: Week’s Best: ETFs Rake In Assets
articles.mainIdea: Week’s Best: ETFs Rake In Assets
articles.summary: Barrons.com: Week’s Best: ETFs Rake In Assets. Investors poured a record amount of money into exchange-traded funds in 2025, according to State Street Investment Management. Net inflows topped $1.5 trillion, eclipsing the previous record of $1.15 trillion set in 2024, and boosting the total amount of money invested in ETFs to $13.4 trillion. Investors poured money into all types of exchange-traded funds last year with flows into bond, gold, and active equity ETFs all hitting records. Related tickers mentioned: GC=F, MS-PQ.
